# Model sources

The STAGE graph-window adapters implement graph-level prediction on windows of flow nodes. [GraphIDS](https://github.com/lorenzo9uerra/GraphIDS) originally uses flow edges and reconstruction-based anomaly scoring. Its [upstream license](GraphIDS-LICENSE.txt) is included here. [DIDS-MFL](https://github.com/qcydm/DIDS-MFL) uses temporal events. This repository provides the STAGE adapter and links to the original method. The DAPT benchmark uses these project adapters.
